notes.title: FRIENDS & TRINKETS UPDATE IS OUT!
notes.content:
Greetings, Caravaneers!

First of all, we'd like to thank everyone that has played Sky Caravan so far! Your feedbacks and reviews are helping us immensely in improving the game.

With that being said, we're happy to announce that a free content update is here!

[b]Friends & Trinkets[/b] brings you new ways to enjoy your story in the clouds — and more consequences to the choices you make:

[h3]✨ [b]Brand new interactions with crewmates![/b][/h3]
Crewmates now have more different dialogues and responses depending on friendship (or rivalry) with each of them. Keep an eye on the affinity you have with each crewmember and see how it changes what they have to say! Will you stay on their good graces? Or will you give them reason to hate you?

[h3]🚀 [b]Trinkets to decorate your ship![/b][/h3]
If you got certain Steam Achievements before, you might notice your ship is looking just a little bit different on the inside. Several achievements are now linked to special trinkets that will appear in the UI — including getting max affinity with a crewmate, which will grant you a cute little bobblehead fashioned after them.

Naturally, since Trinkets are tied to Achievements, they remain between playthroughs. Can you collect them all?

[h3]💸 [b]Summer Sale Price Drop![/b][/h3]
And there's more: to celebrate the update, Sky Caravan has a [b]25% discount[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale!

The update also comes with the following [b]improvements and fixes[/b]:

[list]
[*][b][u]"Restart Day" and "Restart Delivery" options[/u][/b]: after failing a delivery, you are now given two options to restart. The first will place you at the start of the current event, as usual. The second will send you back to the Capy-Bar right before you started that delivery, allowing you to use the Caravan Manager if you need or want to. Keep in mind that the "Restart Delivery" option will be visible after updating the game and starting a new save file. 

This feature was directly requested by the community, and we're happy to bring it to you! Again, thanks for the feedback!

[*][u][b]Stat and delivery reward balancing[/b][/u]: This was done due to community feedbacks about one of the endings being too hard to attain.

[*][u][b]Affinity balancing[/b][/u]: As part of the new interactions present in this update, the affinity gains and losses were rebalanced to better acomodate for these changes.

[*]Fixed a bug in which the Affinity Panel would reset the text to "Distant" despite the current Affinity state being otherwise.

[*]Fixed UI issues on the Caravan Manager screen.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused the mission chips to disappear on the Mission Select screen.
[/list]

See you in the Skyways! ☁️

notes.title: SKY CARAVAN IS OFFICIALLY OUT!
notes.content:
Greetings, Caravaneers!

Sky Caravan is officially out on Steam! 

The time has come to write your story in the clouds! We've worked incredibly hard to bring this tale to life and we can't wait to hear what everyone thinks of it — and what choices you made 🚀 

You can send bug reports and feedbacks by pressing F8 at any point in the game, or reaching out to us here on Steam and on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/hYGMtgPdGa

Leaving reviews helps a lot to get the game noticed! We'd love to hear your opinions ❤️ 

We dedicated a year of our lives for this game and we couldn't be happier right now. Sky Caravan is the first title released by our team — it's only the beginning. 

Safe travels and have fun!

notes.title: Sky Caravan is in Open Beta!
notes.content:
[b]Hello caravaneers![/b]

Good news: Sky Caravan is going into Open Beta! 
To play it, just click the Beta button on the main page. Anyone that is interested is free to join.

We need all the help we can get to find bugs, problems, narrative inconsistencies and whatever else you feel that could use some work so we can get the game into its best form in the home stretch.

To send feedback to us, you can just press F8 at any moment in the game, type and send it. 
You can also talk about the experience with us in our Discord server: https://discord.gg/hYGMtgPdGa

We want to make sure that everyone understands that this is [b]not the game's final form and does not contain the entirety of its content![/b] There's a lot to iron out, bugs to fix and specially in terms of music there are a lot of themes that aren't implemented in the game yet. 

Still, we are confident that this is a good moment to let everyone that is interested get their hands on their game and help us make it truly shine.

The game releases in [b]early May[/b] and we'll reveal the exact release date really soon!

Thanks a lot and we hope you enjoy the Beta and stay with us for the final game!

- Yann

[b]OBS PT-BR:[/b] para os jogadores PT-BR, lamentamos muito mas não conseguimos terminar a localização a tempo do Beta. Ainda estamos traduzindo algumas entregas do jogo, por isso, o Beta só está disponível em inglês. Fiquem tranquilos: o jogo final lançará em português também!

notes.title: Sky Caravan Twitch Integration
notes.content:
[h1][b]WHAT IS THE TWITCH INTEGRATION?[/b][/h1]
Sky Caravan's Twitch integration connects the game directly to a Twitch chat, allowing viewers to vote on choices and decide where the story will go.


[h3][b]STARTUP[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/f5ccb01552dcef526db5a62550d92f327f7ee1f1.jpg[/img]
- On Sky Caravan's main menu (or, alternatively, the pause menu), go to [u]Options[/u], then mark the checkbox labeled [u]Twitch Integration[/u].

- A new tab should appear on the Options menu, titled [u]Stream Settings[/u].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/debf5618341e5396d09f4f9a3d92bf75974ef9fd.jpg[/img]
- On that tab, [u]fill the first blank with your Twitch username[/u]. This is the profile you will use to join the chat. This is the name of your Twitch account itself, not your email. It is also recommended that you use the username of a secondary account instead of your main one. While we used the official Twitch API, it is the best way to guarantee your safety, just in case.

- The [u]second blank should be filled with the name of the channel whose chat will be accessed[/u]. This is the channel your viewers will use to vote for their reaction of choice.

- The [u]third and final blank should be filled with an official OAuth token[/u], which can be obtained by accessing the following link (https://twitchapps.com/tmi/) and allowing the site to access your Twitch channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/e7bbcb418ced87e951647cacfc1504eae9831e40.gif[/img]
- Afterwards, click the [u]Connect[/u] button. If the light on the button's right side turns green and the text says "Online" you should be good to go! Otherwise, an error message should appear. Check our FAQ section for possible solutions.


[h3][b]STARTING A VOTE[/b][/h3]
- [i]IMPORTANT:[/i] Voting only works after the tutorial is over, during the first delivery. You'll know when it's started when its title (The Fifth Passenger) appears onscreen. Otherwise, voting works for every choice in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/c67775657ae5dbe9f9435382aaacbf46e8b02fe6.png[/img]
- When you get to a choice, [u]open the left panel on the UI[/u] (which also contains the game's Affinity Panel) and then [u]click the purple button with the Twitch logo[/u].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/2be4f51148d41e15e09a5d8136102886b87e6dca.gif[/img]
- From there, you can [u]customize the voting period's duration[/u], by using the (+) and (-) buttons.

- Once you're satisfied, press the [u]Start[/u] button. The game will keep count of how many votes each option has and how much time is left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/c06ab5f9edaf337ce47d62e6a94475cbf8ba702b.png[/img]
- If you wish to see the chat in-game, [u]open the right panel[/u] (also the game's Mission Panel) and [u]click on the purple button with the Twitch logo[/u].

- Viewers can vote with the following commands: !vote 1, !vote 2 and !vote 3 - for each of the three possible choices, in order, from left to right. The commands need to be typed exactly as above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/35c3afba21dd744d713693b19e6cfa3fe7b5d59e.gif[/img]
- Afterwards, the option with the most votes will be selected.

- If there's a tie, the game will automatically select the leftmost option.

- You can stop a vote prematurely by pressing the [u]Stop[/u] button.


[h3][b]FAQ[/b][/h3]
- Is the Twitch Integration safe?

R.	Yes. We do not get access to the token at any time, it appears masked in the game screen and is stored only locally on your computer (located on user\AppData\LocalLow\Studio Bravarda\Sky Caravan and named TwitchIntegrationConfig.skc). We only send this token to the twitch API. It is not sent to our server.
	We, nor anyone else, can access your Twitch account using this token. The only reason we suggest using an alternate username in the Stream Settings is in the event your computer itself is somehow compromised by a third party, so they wouldn't have access to that data.
	The only things the Token allows Sky Caravan to do is to read the chat's messages and to send messages back (as if it were a regular Twitch Bot).


- Is the OAuth Token generation safe?

R.	Yes. This site is recommended by Twitch developers' guide (https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/irc/guide), so it is safe.


- Can the Twitch Integration play the game by itself (like Twitch Plays)?

R.	No. The Integration allows viewers to play, but it still requires the streamer to initiate voting and play through non-choice sections.


- Do I need both side panels to be active for the vote to work?

R.	No. The panels can be retracted at any time - though you'll still have to open the left panel so you can start the vote.

notes.title: Demo Version V1.1 - Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Second patch notes for our Demo with two good news and several bug fixes. Now the Demo is pretty much everything we've hoped for and we feel ready for the Steam Next Fest starting today.

Thanks again for everyone who sent feedback! You took a big part in making this game a little better <3

[h2]News:[/h2]
- [b]Twitch Integration 1.0[/b]: you can know connect the game with your Twitch account and play alongside your chat. More info in FAQ we wrote on how it works, just head [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1792270/view/3132820191039890027]here[/url].
- [b]Localization in PT-BR[/b]: Demo can now be played in brazilian portuguese. É isso aí, rapaziada.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- All music and ambience sounds stopping when you go from a delivery to Main Menu
- Ship no longer travels from Aquarela to Aquarela, avoiding unnecessary transitions and duplicated music
- Big face effects like hearts and sparkles now have a slight delay on the changing of characters, avoiding  particles displaying in the character that has just finished talking
- Dozens and dozens of small typos and cohesion problems solved in the narrative of the game

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
- Lots of new SFX added, including Mafagafo sounds and more UI feedback like changing stats in the ship
- New music added for Marimbondo scene
- Added a new screen at Demo end with credits. Yes, we developers focused on the game so much that we forgot to make sure people knew that we were the ones who did it

notes.title: Demo Version V1.0.2 patch notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have our first patch notes for the most recent version of the Demo.

We'd like to thank everyone that has already played the game and either used the feedback screen in-game or reached out to us. It's already making quite a difference in the main gameplay experience!

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
- Reaction disk tooltips now appearing 100% of the time and above the disks instead of in front
- Sad face in feedback pop-up can be now selected
- "Continue" button doesn't disappear in the demo end screen on second playthrough
- Music and ambience in capybar stop playing in case you exit to main menu
- Reaction disk particles appearing in the right spots
- Name typing in the input box doesn't automatically make the first letter uppercase
- Character big-faces wait for the new character to enter to display effects such as blinks, shakes and little particles

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
- Default text speed is now 1.5x faster. You can control in the options menu what is your desired speed, with the option to cycle between 5 options, faster or slower
- Added additional explanation in Capybarman's intro dialogue to the Alert that appears on the panels, making it clearer that they indicate that a numerical change will happen after the decision is made, be it upwards or downwards
- You can now use the keys 1, 2 and 3 of your keyboard to make a decision, in case the player doesn't want to drag and drop the reactions. Also added a line to Capybarman's intro to explain this to the player

[h2]News:[/h2]
- Twitch Integration on pre-beta stage. We'll be conducting some tests before making it available for everyone to make sure everything's working
- Localization in PT-BR is about 50% complete. It will be available by the time Steam Next Fest starts, in 21st of Februrary

notes.title: Play Sky Caravan's Demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey there, caravaneers! 

We're really excited to announce that we'll be [b]officially releasing Sky Caravan's first Demo on Steam Next Fest! [/b]

The festival will happen between[b] 21st-28th Februrary[/b] and it is a great opportunity for us to get lots of feedback on the game and let everyone have their first look into Sky Caravan's experience.

[h2]What is the demo about?[/h2]
You'll play one of the first deliveries of the game, showcasing the main gameplay experience. It has between 30-60 minutes of playtime, but that can be extended since there's lots of of replayability, since you can get different endings depending on your decisions.

[h2]Can I play it now?[/h2]
We have released an early version of the Demo which can be played right now. We're using it to gather some useful feedback and correct bugs before the festival starts. Think of it like an "Early Access Demo" of sorts. It's already helping us a lot and the game is getting better every day. So if you want to play it, we'd love that! Press F8 at any time to give us feedback on it.

[h2]Can I stream it?[/h2]
Yes, please! We'll also be offering full Twitch Integration, meaning your viewers will able to play the game alongside you, voting for choices. It's in testing phase and we hope to roll it out in the next few days. If you stream it, let us know by sending us a message at @studiobravarda on Twitter os posting it here to the Steam Community.

[h2]When is the game coming out?[/h2]
We've moved our release window into April, allowing us more time to polish the game and use the feedback we receive from this festival to make Sky Caravan even better. We're not able to share the exact day of release yet.

We're super happy to be participating this festival and we hope everyone has an awesome time playing Sky Caravan. If anyone has any questions, feel free to ask!

Have fun, caravaneers. See you all at Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: Meet the Crew!
notes.content:
Hey there caravaneers, [b]it's time to introduce your crewmates in Sky Caravan! [/b]

You'll be the captain of a ship of three distinct characters with unique personalities, likes and dislikes. Time to start getting to know them to get ready for your travels next year!

[h2]Barto[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/223970f25bcbde8a0bee8116d8fa4aa1328b8aa1.gif[/img]
[h3]📝 Message from Corporate: "The food is weird. But he's a chef with claws. You better love it."[/h3]

Your short-tempered, grumpy (but talented) cook. The only moment you're guaranteed to see him smile is when the subject of the talk is exotic foods. Otherwise, be sure to keep everyone safe and he won't bother you. 

[h2]Jackie[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/725c68ae2b67d3480e158956b4028f69f3364620.gif[/img]
[h3]📝 Message from Corporate: "A true engineering geek. Has three arms. Two she built herself."[/h3]

Your engineer and the brains of the crew. She might be bubbly, but can get very serious when needed. She spent her youth listening to stories about caravans all over the clouds from her grandma, an experienced retired caravaneer. Now the time has come to put her knowledge to the test. 

[h2]Kleber[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41523834/a155018a80abc056aaf1e29733cf89d90bf147ca.gif[/img]
[h3]📝 Message from Corporate: "Experienced, but reckless driver. Perfect combination for a caravan pilot."[/h3]

Your streetwise pilot. He's a bit shady sometimes - but always down for adventure. He's a navigator, ex-sky taxi driver and, as we call here in Brazil, a tremendous [i]trambiqueiro[/i], or crook. Get to know him and you'll see he has a heart of gold to accompany his flashy looks.

--

Who will be your best friend? Who will be your rival? That's something only your choices can determine. Stay tuned and get ready for the journey in March 2022.

[h3][b]We're planning a closed playtest soon![/b][/h3]
If you want to take part in it, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/hYGMtgPdGa

See you later!

notes.title: Announcing Sky Caravan!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, caravaneers! [/h1]

I'm Yann, one of Sky Caravan's developers! We're really happy to have finally announced this game that we've been working on for the past six months.

This is the first game that will be released by our company, Studio Bravarda, so there are lots of butterflies in our stomach - but it's also crazy exciting! 

This project is the culmination of our desire to make a deeply responsive narrative game, that listens to players and responds in surprising ways, and our love for the visuals of Disney's movie "Treasure Planet", which blew our minds when we were little kids. Insert a bunch of brazilian flavors and what you get is Sky Caravan!

We'll send updates for Sky Caravan here on Steam in the coming months leading to our March 2022 release, but we're also active on our Discord server! Community is everything and we'd love to gather around everyone that is interested!

Join us there to get even closer to the game's development. Here's a link: 

https://discord.gg/hYGMtgPdGa

You can also follow us on our Social Media channels to check gameplay gifs and cool news!

https://twitter.com/studiobravarda
https://www.instagram.com/studiobravarda/

Share our Steam Page and gameplay trailer with friends! We'll be super happy and it really helps the game start to get noticed. Just grab this link down here and fire away:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1792270/Sky_Caravan/

That's it for now, but [b]this is only the beginning of the journey[/b]. Looking forward to sending you all on a trip to the Skyways!

--

P.S.: There's one other game of ours in development, but it will be released after Sky Caravan. It's called Terra Pulse, and we'd love if you checked it out too! It's a metroidvania game set in the ruins of Rio de Janeiro: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343800/Terra_Pulse/
